mapper.sql: campaign_id, name, type, status, segment_id, template_id, coupon_id, scheduled_at, trigger_type, started_at, ended_at, created_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO campaign (name, type, status, segment_id, template_id, coupon_id, scheduled_at, trigger_type, created_by) VALUES (#{name}, #{type}, #{status}, #{segmentId}, #{templateId}, #{couponId}, #{scheduledAt}, #{triggerType}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE campaign SET name = #{name}, segment_id = #{segmentId}, template_id = #{templateId}, coupon_id = #{couponId}, scheduled_at = #{scheduledAt}, trigger_type = #{triggerType}, updated_at = now() WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId}
UPDATE campaign SET status = #{newStatus}, updated_at = now() WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
UPDATE campaign SET status = 'SCHEDULED', scheduled_at = #{scheduledAt}, updated_at = now() WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND status = 'DRAFT'
UPDATE campaign SET status = 'DRAFT', scheduled_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND status = 'SCHEDULED'
UPDATE campaign SET status = 'ACTIVE', started_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'SCHEDULED')
